From that <term>utpala</term> <gloss>blue lotus</gloss> arises the blue Tara with two hands. Her right hand holds a <term>trishula</term> <gloss>trident</gloss>, and her left hand holds an <term>utpala</term> <gloss>blue lotus</gloss> with a stem. Her beautiful body is adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various types of ornaments. She is in the bloom of youth, with a smiling face, and sits in the posture of equal meditation upon a moon and lotus seat.
